Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide. We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios. We're looking for an ambitious Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them. If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you. You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate. Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting. Your Mission Understand Customer Problems Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving. Build Products End-to-End Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production. Create Intuitive User Experiences Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently. Develop AI-Powered Features Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently. Connect the Ecosystem Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem. review_candidates.title: Performance Marketer
review_candidates.description: Job description: Performance Marketer Role Description: We’re looking for a data-driven performance marketer who enjoys turning a budget into results and proving it with numbers. You will live in the ad accounts. You will build campaigns across different platforms, watch how they perform, and keep tuning them until they deliver. Some experiments will fly. Some will flop. The fun is in finding out which is which, fast. A good day looks like a hunch that paid off, a test that told you something useful, or a cost that dropped because you spotted the leak before anyone else did. You will dig into the data, brief sharper creative, and keep an eye on where every rand goes. What you own: These are the outcomes you will be accountable for: Lead volume and quality from various channels, hit consistently against a monthly target. Cost per qualified lead, kept within an agreed range while volume grows. Return on ad spend across the channels you run. Clear, honest, vanity-free weekly reporting on what is working, what is not, and what you are changing. Responsibilities: Plan, build and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads and Meta, with LinkedIn and other channels as we expand. Run rigorous testing. Form a consolidated view, test, read results, then scale what works and kill what does not. Use analytics tools to measure performance and turn the numbers into clear next actions, not just dashboards. Use keyword research, audience segmentation and competitor analysis to guide where the budget goes. Work closely with the creative team to brief and shape ad creative that is built to convert, backed by data. Manage budgets carefully, spending where it returns and pulling back where it does not. Work directly with the Head of Marketing, take feedback well, and bring your own thinking to the table. What you need: We care more about how fast you learn than how long you have been doing this. Fast learning. Our tools, platforms and tactics change constantly. You pick up new systems quickly and turn them into results without being walked through every step. A sharp analytical mind. You are comfortable with data, you trust evidence over opinion, and you can read a number and know what it is telling you. Paid media experience. Two to four years running paid campaigns with results you can talk through. A strong track record matters more than years on a CV. Strong Excel and analytics skills. You can structure data, build a clear view, and report what matters without drowning it in detail. A team player. You do your best work with people, not around them. You share what you learn and you raise the people around you. A relevant qualification, or equivalent proof that you can do the work. Advantageous Skills: Working knowledge of SEO, on-page, off-page and technical. Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz or Hotjar. An understanding of conversion rate optimization and landing page testing methodologies. Experience in a fast-moving, competitive digital environment.

review_candidates.title: Nurse - Medical Surgical Telemetry - 5 West
review_candidates.description: Serious Medicine is what we do. Being extraordinary is who we are. Every colleague plays a key role in upholding this promise to our patients and their families. Shift Nurse - Med Surg Telemetry - 5 West Position Highlights 5 West is a 40-bed non specialty med-surg unit caring for patients ages 18 and older. The staff cares for a variety of medical and telemetry patients with acute and/or chronic illness, such as sepsis, respiratory, gastrointestinal, endocrine, cardiac disease, and COVID-19. Staff members will manage titratable drips, chest tubes, tracheostomies, complex wound care, post-bariatric procedures, high oxygen delivery systems and end-of-life care. 5 West is known as the “5 West Wolfpack” because of its outstanding teamwork. Its centralized nursing station allows staff to build camaraderie, learn and grow together. The culture and close-knit environment on 5 West make this unit ideal for new and experienced nurses. It is the only unit in the hospital to have a Zen room, which features a massage chair, adult coloring books and other materials to support staff who need to reset their mindset. The staff and leaders on our team are passionate about mentoring, professional development, and finding new and innovative ways to care for patients! 5 West leaders support their new staff by providing in depth orientation, goal planning, progress meetings and check-ins 30/60/90 days post-orientation completion. All new graduate nurses get to attend nurse residency and encompassed in that program is a medical-surgical fellowship to enhance knowledge on various disease processes for new graduate nurses. 5 West will transition to a team-based care delivery model in January 2025. Team based care is a group of licensed and unlicensed healthcare professionals working in unison towards a common goal to care for a group of patients. Our team-based care delivery model consists of Lead Nurses, Registered Nurses, Virtual Nurses, Licensed Practical Nurses, and Nursing Assistants. Virtual nurses are incorporated into the team to perform administrative tasks that require an RN license but do not require physical presence (i.e., admission and discharge paperwork, patient education, dual nurse sign offs, etc.). Team based care allows for nurses to work at the top of their scope and effectively uses each team member’s strengths, skills, and experiences as well as promotes teamwork, communication, and leadership. Leading Health Network Work with the region’s top academic health network, partnering with UNMC to transform lives through education, research, and patient care. Diversity and Inclusion We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, reflecting the communities we serve. Relocation Support Relocation package: $3,000 for adjoining states, $4,500 for non-adjoining states. Be part of something extraordinary at Nebraska Medicine! Environment of care may be long term, emergent, critical, acute, interventional, or procedural driven. Required Qualifications Associate’s degree in nursing (ADN) or Nursing Diploma required. Effective communication skills required. Ability to demonstrate initiative, teamwork and flexibility required. Currently licensed as a Registered Nurse in the state of Nebraska or current compact state license required. Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required, must be from an American Heart Association (AHA) endorsed program (effective for new hires starting January 1, 2023 or later). Bachelor's degree in nursing (BSN) or Master's of Science in Nursing (MSN) degree preferred.
